veranderings.rede: 'Terug' suggests something is returned; 'daarvoor' says plainly that the salt is what he gets in exchange.

veranderings.voor: loop die boer met sy sak weg
veranderings.na: bly die boer met sy mielies sit
veranderings.rede: No sack has been mentioned, so 'sy sak' has no clear referent; 'met iets bly sit' is the natural idiom for being stuck with goods nobody takes.

veranderings.voor: Vis en melk bly ook nie lank goed nie en raak gou sleg.
veranderings.na: Vis en melk raak ook gou sleg.
veranderings.rede: The two halves say the same thing twice; one clause keeps the meaning and reads more cleanly.
''n Heel ander mens' is the idiom for a person who has changed; 'iemand heeltemal anders' means a different person without that reading.
